name: pilot-2026-11-23-blocked-industry
description: The pilot request as tested on 2026-11-23 (no 'Companies must be B2B' sentence), WITHOUT review-only. The four sector industries are one required any-of group that no approved step can prove (a LinkedIn industry label is plausible, never proof), so the plan is blocked and asks ONE question for the group, not four. 'Consumer-only' is decided by the website business-model step, so it is checked and asks nothing.
query: Find up to 5 active B2B companies headquartered in the United States, preferably with 10–200 employees, operating in commercial contracting, industrial distribution, commercial field services, or manufacturing, that are currently hiring Account Executives. Exclude consumer-only companies, non-US headquarters, and duplicates.
